label_source: derived/pseudo labels from each field's real NDVI trajectory
optical_gap_handling: causal field-wise forward-fill + optical_valid mask; no back-fill
evi_cleaning: values outside [-1,1] converted to NaN before train-only median imputation
evaluation_warning: If growth_stage_pseudo is used, the confusion matrix measures agreement with derived NDVI trajectory labels, not independent field truth.
